final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS rating_average FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rating_average) AS overall_mean FROM rating_averages) SELECT rating, rating_average, rating_average - overall_mean AS above_overall_mean FROM rating_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE rating_average > overall_mean ORDER BY rating
